confirmed_swings.lookback_requirement: 2 candles on each side; candidate i is confirmed after i+2
confirmed_swings.state_transition: when a new candle closes, evaluate the newly confirmable candle
confirmed_swings.invalidation: none after confirmation in the current implementation

atr.state_transition: append true range and evict value older than 14
atr.output: current ATR and historical ATR values used by the current snapshot

ema_context.inputs: completed closes, forming close, EMA periods 20/50/100/200, cross and touch history
ema_context.lookback_requirement: EMA recurrence plus retained cross/touch event history
ema_context.state_transition: update EMA recurrence and append newly observable events
ema_context.output: EMA values, slopes, ordering, crosses, touches, compression

build_zones.inputs: all confirmed pivots, current ATR tolerance, all candles after each zone first_seen
build_zones.lookback_requirement: full confirmed-pivot history and full candle history for reactions and role flips
build_zones.state_transition: not represented as a stable append-only transition in current code
build_zones.invalidation: ATR tolerance can change clustering of previously observed pivots; role can flip based on any later close
build_zones.output: zones, reaction arrays, role flips, nearest support/resistance
build_zones.reason: Re-clustering with a changed tolerance can merge or split old zones; reaction and role-flip arrays are historical projections over those zones.

trendline_candidates.inputs: last 24 confirmed pivots plus every candle from each left anchor through current time
trendline_candidates.lookback_requirement: bounded pivot candidate set but unbounded interaction interval
trendline_candidates.state_transition: candidate pairs can be updated incrementally only with per-pair retained interaction state
trendline_candidates.invalidation: new pivots alter the retained 24-pivot set
trendline_candidates.output: touches, meaningful interaction episodes, violations and penetration history

channel_candidates.inputs: last 24 confirmed pivots, all valid top/bottom combinations, current ATR and current close
channel_candidates.lookback_requirement: bounded pivot combinations but current geometry changes every update
channel_candidates.state_transition: new pivot combinations can be added; old combinations need current geometry refresh
channel_candidates.invalidation: retained pivot window and ATR-dependent slope filter

conclusion.reason: The frozen feature contract includes historical zone reaction/role-flip arrays and dynamic ATR-based clustering. Replacing these with bounded state without a semantic redesign would not prove exact equivalence.
